issues.description: The problem statement requires a modifiable List<Meal> attribute called 'orders' in SealSaloon, but both the provided template helpers and the reference solution use plain arrays (Meal[]) for orders and array helper utilities. This mismatch between the specified type (List) and the actual array-based implementation in the template/solution can confuse students about which collection type to use and which APIs are available (List methods vs. ArrayHelpers functions).
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the problem statement to allow and describe using an array-based orders attribute (Meal[]) and mention ArrayHelpers, or modify the template to provide a List-based orders field (List<Meal>) and corresponding utilities (e.g., use ArrayList and List APIs) so the problem text and starter code consistently refer to the same collection type.
